description: Defines a SwiftUI View named VoiceWakeTestCard that provides UI for testing voice wake functionality, displaying different states such as idle, requesting permission, listening, detecting speech, finalizing, and failure.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTestCard
classes.description: A SwiftUI View managing the UI for voice wake testing, including control buttons, status indicators, and descriptive texts based on ViewModel states.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the SwiftUI view layout, including status icon, toggle button, and status text based on current testState.

methods.name: statusIcon
methods.description: Provides visual feedback (icon) depending on the current state of voice test.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Provides status message string depending on the current test state.
